instruction: Candid documentary medium wide shot of a park. On the left, the large Black man in a dark blue t-shirt (R1) holds a blue frisbee and points forward. On the right, the woman in a dark blue t-shirt and light blue jeans (R4) points upward, looking intensely at him. In the background, the East Asian man in a red polo (R3) and the woman in a black beanie and red t-shirt (R5) holding a red frisbee over her face watch the interaction. Bright daylight casts soft shadows on the green grass.
